in_marathi.name: Manvendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rule by Mantra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manvendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manvendra is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: Manas (mind) and Vendra (rule). The name signifies ruling the mind with the power of mantras and wisdom. This name is associated with powerful rulers and spiritual leaders in Hindu mythology.
